limits.description: No opened discard pile appears anywhere in this source; visible top discard cards and play history do not establish a full pile.
Opponent hand identities and hidden draw/search results remain unknown except publicly revealed Koffing.
Draw-end times are visual approximations; frame requested seek times are preserved, actual decoder frame PTS was not separately measured.
Opponent connection intent and actual disconnect cause are not established.
QR and live log use semantic card variants; artwork/rarity exact printings are not established.
